dedupe_keys.name: data to reproduce the cim citysim coupling on the epfl campus neighbourhood building energy with an urban canopy model

description: This dataset lets users rerun the coupling of the Canopy Interface Model (CIM) with the CitySim urban energy simulator for the EPFL campus in Ecublens, near Lausanne, Switzerland, from the PLOS ONE paper on multi-scale modelling of building energy at neighbourhood scale. It was published on Zenodo on 23 August 2017 by Dasaraden Mauree, Silvia Coccolo and Jean-Louis Scartezzini of EPFL's Solar Energy and Building Physics Laboratory and Jérôme Kaempf of HEIA-FR Fribourg. Files include a Meteonorm climate file for Ecublens and its CIM-adjusted version, ground surface temperature and geometric characteristics of the campus, the CIM executable, measured wind speed, temperature and wind direction at 2 metres and on the laboratory rooftop at 12 metres for 2015, and the matching CIM simulations. Coverage: the EPFL campus for 2015. Access: small text and climate files on Zenodo; further data from the corresponding author. Licence: CC BY-NC-ND 4.0; free for non-commercial use without derivatives. Caveats: the CitySim campus model itself is not in the file list. Simulation uses: validating urban microclimate corrections of weather files for building energy models. Related records: the ENVI-met Milan and Pescara data and the Brazil future weather files.
